column3: a golden laurel wreath encircling an upward-pointing radiant crystal.
a watchful owl with wide glowing amber eyes perched on the crossguard of an upright dagger.
a fully drawn wooden longbow seen from the side, the nocked arrow's tip glowing faintly.
a radiant longsword thrust through a cracked round shield, golden sparks.
two small linked swirling violet portals, a streak of silver light leaping between them.
a wooden spindle spinning three threads, one silver, one dark, one glowing gold.
a heavy warhammer smashing through a shimmering blue magical barrier that shatters into shards.
an open spellbook with a ring of arcane light and swirling energy rising from its pages.
an empty dark hooded cloak dissolving into wisps of shadow beneath a small silver crescent moon.
an eye-shaped crystal amulet on a golden chain, radiating piercing white rays.
a smith's hammer, tongs and chisel crossed over a small anvil, a few orange sparks.
a heavy steel kite shield with a brass boss, two arrows glancing off it.
two muscular forearms locked in a tight wrestling grip, leather bracers.
a massive two-handed greataxe held diagonally, a motion streak of its swing.
an open leather healer's kit with rolled bandages, herb bundles and small glass vials.
a gleaming gold coin balanced on its edge beside a four-leaf clover, small sparkles.
a plain wooden apprentice's wand with a small spark of violet arcane fire at its tip.
a polished wooden lute with drifting musical notes made of golden light.
a jagged notched battle axe with a bold red impact slash across the blade.
an arrow splitting another arrow in the center of a round straw archery target.
a fan of different tools — a quill, a set of lockpicks, a coil of rope and a small hand lens.
a bare fist smashing a wooden tankard, ale and foam splashing outward.
a dented iron breastplate with a glowing deep-red heart shining through its center.
a pair of crossed curved short swords, steel gleaming.
a theatrical half-mask, one side smiling and one side frowning, a curl of silver mimicry-mist drifting from its mouth.
a knotted climbing rope coiled around a leather sandal with small dust-trail wings, mid-leap motion lines.
a dark blindfold tied around the blade of an upright shortsword, faint pale sound-ripples radiating from the steel.
a round crystal ward split into colored segments of fire, frost and lightning, each deflecting a small spark.
a massive iron-bound oak heart with a glowing crimson core and golden rivets.
a cracked hourglass whose sand flows upward, mending golden light sealing the cracks.
an open hand cradling a cluster of small golden tool and book emblems orbiting a bright star.
a winged boot leaving a streak of silver afterimages, a blur of motion behind it.
a lowered lance tip bursting through a spray of dust, sharp forward motion lines.
a steaming iron cooking pot with a wooden ladle and a sprig of herbs, warm green healing glow in the steam.
a cocked hand crossbow seen from the side, a bolt loaded and two spare bolts fanned behind it.
a heavy flanged mace striking a cracked stone, shards flying outward.
a slender rapier crossing and parrying another blade, a bright flash of sparks at the bind.
two longswords crossed in an X, both edges gleaming.
a single upright rapier with an elegant swept hilt, a small golden glint at its point.
a weathered iron canteen and a sturdy bandage roll beside a small glowing ember of life.
a small orb split into four swirling elements, flame, frost, lightning and acid, crackling against each other.
a silver feather crowned with tiny luminous petals and drifting motes of pale green fey light.
a huge two-handed greataxe mid-swing, a heavy arc of motion and impact sparks.
an upright suit of full plate armor's breastplate and pauldrons, polished steel.
a plate gauntlet clenched in a fist with an arrow shattering against its knuckles.
a tattered war banner on a pole, golden rays of light streaming from behind it.
a round shield sliding between a falling sword blade and empty space, blocking the strike with sparks.
a stylized brain-shaped knot of glowing blue threads inside a crystal sphere.
a supple leather jerkin with stitched seams and a buckled belt.
a dagger piercing a glowing violet arcane rune, the rune cracking apart.
a weapon rack holding a longsword, a battleaxe and a warhammer side by side.
a gleaming breastplate with a nimble dagger tucked at its side, light silver motion lines.
a scale mail vest beside a round wooden shield.
a horse's armored head in profile beside a raised lance pennant.
an ornate spyglass with a wide open eye reflected in its lens.
a spear point and an arrowhead crossing, both tips gleaming red.
a small stoppered vial of green poison dripping onto a dagger blade.
a glaive and a quarterstaff crossed, the glaive's butt end glowing as if striking.
a kite shield raised high casting a protective golden glow downward.
a sturdy stone pillar wrapped in a band of glowing golden script, unbowed by a gust of wind.
an open ritual book on a stand ringed by small lit candles, a faint circle of glowing runes.
an upright halberd planted firmly, a watchful glowing eye sigil on its blade.
a wisp of black smoke shaped like a hand, with a faint violet glow at its fingertips.
a heavy round shield bashing forward, a shockwave ring bursting from its rim.
a set of thieves' tools, a quill and a small compass arranged around a golden star.
a hooded cloak fading into shadow, a single dagger glinting from its folds.
a curved scimitar with a bright red slash arc trailing from its edge.
a pair of running boots with streaks of wind and dust behind them.
a glowing magical bolt flying through a crosshair-like ring of arcane runes.
a stone floating above an open palm, rippling blue psionic waves around it.
two stylized heads in silhouette connected by a glowing violet thread of thought.
a spinning handaxe and a javelin in flight, curved motion trails behind them.
a wrapped fist with cloth hand-wraps punching forward, an impact burst at the knuckles.
a sword and a glowing spell focus wand crossed, arcane sparks where they meet.
a polished longsword lying across a whetstone, a golden mastery sigil glowing on the blade.
